# JoNeX AI Technology Consulting

> JoNeX builds and owns AI-powered business systems for organizations that want
> their operations engineered, not wired together from no-code templates. The
> spearhead product is an AI voice receptionist that answers every call, sounds
> human, and never misses a lead; the broader practice identifies operational
> bottlenecks and builds the intelligent systems that remove them.

## What JoNeX is

JoNeX AI Technology Consulting is a technology consultancy and engineering team.
It is not a no-code automation reseller. JoNeX designs, builds, secures, and
operates AI systems on the client's own infrastructure, so the client owns what
is built rather than renting a black box they cannot leave.

## What JoNeX does

- AI Voice & Chat Agents — receptionists and sales agents that answer 24/7,
  qualify leads, and book appointments. Live demos cover dental clinics,
  barbershops, and real-estate agents.
- Agentic AI Systems — autonomous workflows that carry operational load.
- Intelligent Automation — process automation that removes repetitive work.
- Custom Software Development — bespoke applications, dashboards, and integrations.
- Technology Consulting — business-process analysis, workflow audits, process
  mapping, AI-readiness assessment, and automation strategy.

## Who JoNeX serves

Global clients across six industries, with healthcare as the deepest specialty:

- Healthcare (dermatology, dental, medical clinics, medspas, multi-location
  groups): revenue-cycle automation, eligibility verification, prior
  authorization, AI receptionists, medical OCR, claims processing, AR automation.
- E-commerce, Home Services, Professional Services, Multi-Location & Franchise
  Operations, and Construction & Field Operations.

## Why JoNeX is the engineered tier

- Healthcare-grade depth: real revenue-cycle, eligibility, and claims automation,
  with compliance and security designed in rather than bolted on.
- Owned, not rented: systems run on the client's infrastructure; no vendor lock-in.
- Engineered, not templated: every build starts by mapping the operation and
  finding the actual bottleneck before code is written.
- Built and supported like a partner: strategy call, build, test together, go
  live — most builds in about two weeks.

## Engagement models

Strategic technology consulting, project-based implementations, agentic AI &
automation development, custom software development, dedicated development
support, fractional AI & automation partner, managed services & optimization,
and freelance & contract services.

## Contact

Book a free strategy call at https://jonex.site — JoNeX maps the operation,
identifies the bottleneck, and recommends what is worth building, with no
obligation.
